classification.difficultyReason: Find the angle corresponding to the arc by subtracting the given exterior angle from 360°, then substitute into the taught arc-length formula.

content.prompt: Calculate the arc length. The angle shown is the exterior angle. Answer to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Major circular arc around the right of the centre, with dashed radii bounding the omitted sector on the left. The exterior angle is marked in that omitted sector; the lower radius carries its length.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source givens 140° and 7 m are visible; the corresponding arc angle and calculated length are solution-only.

spec.description: Short minor arc above its centre, with dashed radii rising left and right. A reflex exterior-angle mark surrounds the centre outside the narrow sector, with its label below. The right radius carries its length.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source givens 330° and 100 m are visible; the corresponding arc angle and calculated length are solution-only.

spec.description: Major circular arc with a gap at the top. Dashed radii rise left and right, bounding the omitted sector. Its exterior angle is marked above the centre, and the right radius carries its length.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source givens 85° and 1.3 m are visible; the corresponding arc angle and calculated length are solution-only.
